name: shopmalty
description: ShopMalty – Multi Vendor E-Commerce Marketplace is a full-stack web based application which will allow multiple vendors, shops, products, orders and finances to be managed.
details: ShopMalty was created to help manage the multiple vendors within an e-commerce marketplace. The main concept of the project was to create a central platform for multiple sellers, customers and admins.The system allows for Super Admins, Sellers and Customers to have unique dashboards. It also allows for sellers to be verified, products be approved, shops, orders and seller finances to be managed.This project aims to make the marketplace more organised and easy to manage
